designationHistory.indexText: President Coolidge set aside the Ozark National Game Refuges Numbers One through Four in the Ozark National Forest; whether Barkshead was one of these four has not been confirmed.

authority.citation: Proclamation of Apr. 26, 1926, 44 Stat. 2611 (under Act of Feb. 28, 1925, 43 Stat. 1091)

designationHistory.note: The proclamations number the Ozark refuges (Nos. 1-4 in 1926, No. 5 in 1928) and do not name them. No source was found that matches the name Barkshead to a refuge number, so the establishing date could be Apr. 26, 1926 or June 13, 1928. Check the Ozark-St. Francis National Forests' records or the proclamation diagrams.
